bibliography.title: Marginal Structural Models to Estimate the Causal Effect of Zidovudine on the Survival of HIV-Positive Men

final_version_verification: Original typeset Epidemiology pages 561–570, volume 11 issue 5, September 2000, copyright Lippincott Williams & Wilkins; Harvard author-hosted final published copy. Title, authors, pages, DOI checked against PubMed PMID10955409 and Crossref. Not the adjacent methodological article pp550–560.

text_extraction.method: pdftotext -layout; every PDF page retained and labelled === PDF PAGE n ===

Domain priors are not presented as physical necessities. No framework assessment performed.
